# DigiHash – DigiByte Community Mining Pool

> DigiHash (https://digihash.digibyte.io) is an open-source community mining pool for DigiByte (DGB). It supports all 5 DigiByte mining algorithms: SHA256, Scrypt, Skein, Qubit and Odocrypt. Miners connect over stratum with a DigiByte address as the username. No account or sign-up is needed. The pool fee is 10% on SHA256, Scrypt, Skein and Qubit, and 9.5% on Odocrypt. The home page says the fee goes to a community fund to support DigiByte development. The minimum payout is 25 DGB.

## Pages

- [Home](https://digihash.digibyte.io/): Pool overview, fee, minimum payout, and live miners and hashrate for each algorithm.
- [Getting Started](https://digihash.digibyte.io/getting_started): Connection details for each algorithm: stratum URL, ports and starting difficulty.
- [Pool Stats](https://digihash.digibyte.io/stats): Live pool and network hashrate, miners, workers, luck and blocks for each algorithm.
- [Worker Stats](https://digihash.digibyte.io/workers): Miners and workers on each pool, with a lookup by DigiByte address.
- [Payments](https://digihash.digibyte.io/payments): Payment history: blocks found, DGB paid to miners, and transaction links.
- [Tab Stats](https://digihash.digibyte.io/tbs): All pools in one table: workers, valid and invalid shares, blocks and hashrate.
- [API](https://digihash.digibyte.io/api): List of the pool's JSON API endpoints (stats, blocks, payments, worker stats, live stats).

## How to connect

- Stratum URL: `stratum+tcp://digihash.digibyte.io:<port>`
- Username: your DigiByte (DGB) wallet address. To name a worker, add a dot and a name: `<address>.rig1`.
- Password: anything.
- Each algorithm has 3 ports. The pool adjusts difficulty for each miner (variable difficulty). The number in brackets is the starting difficulty.
- SHA256: 3008 (25000), 3032 (250000), 3256 (2500000)
- Scrypt: 3009 (8192), 3033 (32768), 3257 (131072)
- Skein: 3011 (0.001), 3035 (5), 3259 (10)
- Qubit: 3012 (0.01), 3036 (1), 3260 (5)
- Odocrypt: 3013 (0.01), 3037 (1), 3261 (16)
- Payouts go to the mining address after its balance reaches 25 DGB. Block rewards are paid after the block is confirmed on the DigiByte blockchain.

## Data notes

- Stats, blocks and payments come live from the pool and its DigiByte nodes. The numbers change all the time.
- Pool hashrate is an estimate made from the shares that miners submit.
- The JSON API is under `https://digihash.digibyte.io/api/` (for example `/api/stats`). The site says the API is work in progress and can change.
- Transaction and block links point to the DigiExplorer block explorer.

## About

- DigiHash V2 is free, open-source software under the MIT License. It was forked from NOMP by ROZ, created by Jared Tate, and is supported by the DigiByte developers.
- DigiByte is an open-source blockchain. No company is behind it.
- [Source code](https://github.com/JaredTate/digihashv2): DigiHash V2 pool software on GitHub.
- [DigiByte.org](https://digibyte.org): The DigiByte project website.
- [DigiByte.io](https://digibyte.io): DigiByte blockchain stats.
- [DigiExplorer](https://digiexplorer.info): DigiByte block explorer.
- [Sitemap](https://digihash.digibyte.io/sitemap.xml): All public pages of this site.
